_readme: Prompt data for music/generate.py. The four styles are the ones Tyler said fit GRAVITAS in Music test runs 5, 6, and 7 (2026-10-20 and 21): dark cinematic hybrid, epic dark orchestral, dark drill, and dark orchestral drill (run 7 prompt 4, a mix of the drill and orchestral styles). The pillar is (days since start_date) mod 3, in pillar_order. The style turns over daily (days + days // number of styles), so no two days in a row match and each style meets each pillar. Each day then picks a bpm, three instruments, and a texture from that style, and a mood for the day's pillar, seeded by the date. The written prompt keeps the shape of the winning test prompts. Keep everything English, no artist names, no song titles, no vocals.
